summary: The PrqConfidentiality user control is a part of the HSPnet system dealing with staff profile management, particularly around confidentiality agreements. It includes several UI components such as grid views, form views, buttons, and update panels for handling consent forms and prerequisites for staff members. The functionality supports adding, editing, deleting, and displaying confidentiality agreements and related data.
purpose: The purpose of the PrqConfidentiality user control is to manage staff confidentiality forms and prerequisites within the HSPnet system, facilitating the handling of staff consent and related agreements.
business_rules: Only users with permission can edit or delete confidentiality forms.
If the user session is null, operations are canceled.
validations: Page must be valid before inserting or updating operations.
Ensure user session is active before selecting data.
conditions: If ScreenIsEditable is true, enable edit buttons.
Disable edit fields if Disabled or ScreenIsEditable is false.
system_behavior: The system caches the user session after data modifications.
Page redirects are performed after insert, update, or delete operations.
exceptions: Operations are canceled if the user session is null.
